description: Remove a waiting price alert so it never fires. Use when the user no longer wants it or to make room (at most 20 wait). Not for orders (use cancel_open_order). Input: alert_id from get_my_price_alerts. An app can delete only the alerts it created. Next: get_my_price_alerts.
name: cancel_price_alert

direction.description: above: fires when the price is at or above the level; below: at or below
